steps.detail: Raw order-line export rows loaded as text
Identical rows re-sent by the export were removed
Category casing variants (e.g. 'FURNITURE', 'electronics') mapped to conformed names after trimming
Region casing variants mapped to conformed names after trimming
Legacy channel names (e.g. 'Web Store', 'Wholesale') mapped to 4 conformed channels
Lines whose product name/category disagreed with the product master
Parsed US dates (MM/DD/YYYY), currency text ($1,234.56) and percent text (15%)
Blank ship dates kept as blank: orders still open at the 2025-12-31 extract (not imputed)
Reported Line Total did not equal Qty x Price x (1 - Discount); replaced by recomputed net sales (overstatement removed: $2,367.57)
Customers in the CRM with no 2023-2025 orders kept in DimCustomer (ValueTier = 'No purchases')
Finance target rows loaded from Excel
Fact rows written; tables: FactSales, FactSalesTarget, DimDate, DimProduct, DimCustomer, DimGeography, DimSalesChannel
